page.content:
Continent of Emon, Whitestone, and Vox Machina's first roads.

How Tal'Dorei connects

  • Location: Exandria — Tal'Dorei is a continent of Exandria.
  • Location: Whitestone — Whitestone stands in Tal'Dorei.
  • Work: Campaign 1 — Campaign 1 is set largely on Tal'Dorei.

What is Tal'Dorei?

Tal'Dorei is the continent of Campaign 1: Emon under the Cloud and then the Conclave, Whitestone of the de Rolos, and the Ashari at Zephrah.

Key threads lead to Exandria, Whitestone and Campaign 1.
